title: Where the lease and the guidance both speak, the lease is cited

input.message: האם צריך לתאם מראש כניסה לדירה לצורך תיקון?

grounding.note: The tenant's own contract outranks a company procedure. Both corpora answer this — §7.4 says the landlord may enter to carry out a repair after coordinating in advance, and נוהל כניסה לדירה adds the 24-hour notice and the alternative date — and the lease is what the tenant signed. Written expecting 'policy' and corrected by npm run measure rather than by an argument.
